cpl.name: HyperGSD Priorities
cpl.title: yan/hypergsd-priorities
cpl.readme:
A set of three priorities you can apply to HyperGSD actions and projects.

| Field | Meaning |h
| `gsd_priority` | `A` (high), `B` (medium) or `C` (low). Empty is treated as not set. |

You can configure the appearance of these priorities and set the default priority in the [[Priorities settings|$:/plugins/yan/hypergsd-priorities/ui/control-panel/priorities]].

! Where priorities appear

* Action and project panels
** Option to enable in modals
* Action and project list rows
* Every list's ''Sort by'' control gains a ''Priority'' option
* Every list's ''Group by'' control gains a ''Priority'' option
